description: Asymmetric binary loss for multilabel logits with separate positive and negative focusing exponents and a margin shift for negative probabilities; sums labels per example before batch reduction.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    targets = (features[:2] > 1.0).float()
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(targets)}
ds = synth.Spec("asl-multilabel", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "asl", "loss_kwargs": {"gamma_pos": 0.0, "gamma_neg": 4.0, "margin": 0.05}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a multilabel model with asymmetric loss

name: Asymmetric loss for multi-label classification

parameters.gamma_neg: finite nonnegative focusing exponent for negative labels (default 4.0)
parameters.gamma_pos: finite nonnegative focusing exponent for positive labels (default 0.0)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because ignored binary labels are unsupported
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point logits with shape [B, K], one value per label
parameters.margin: finite nonnegative shift subtracted from negative probabilities (default 0.05)
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example label sums; mean or sum reduces examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: binary tensor with shape [B, K], matching logits
